relationships.subject: Epidural analgesia
relationships.evidence_quote: VAS scores were lower and the analgesia satisfaction was higher in the pharmaceutical analgesia group than in the nonpharmaceutical analgesia group (all p < .05).

key_findings: Epidural analgesia gave lower VAS and lower serum SP, NPY, NGF and PGE2 than nonpharmaceutical (TENS) analgesia, but longer labor and more postpartum bleeding.
